children: Japanese government bond yields are higher as concerns about the Iran conflict and inflation continue. Higher imported energy costs, coupled with prospects of strong artificial intelligence-related investments, have raised expectations for the Bank of Japan's additional rate increases. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East and crude oil prices after President Trump rejected Iran's proposal for a seven-day ceasefire. The 10-year JGB yield is up 2 basis points at 3.095%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
